   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

Rooms.Name: The Headwaters Of The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
A large natural spring issues forth from the heart of the mountain
and flows west down the mountain.  It looks like there was a terrible
earthquake here not too long ago, and a path that leads eastwards
through the mountains is covered with rocks, making passage difficult.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river flows down the mountain through a large crevasse to the west
and up into the mountains east.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The walls of this canyon tower overhead as the river continues east
and west from here.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The walls of rock around you slowly shrink to ground level as the river 
flows out of the mountains and onto the plains.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river continues east and west from here out of the foothills
to the east down into the mountains south of here.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river, following a low spot in the foothills, bends and twists.
Tall mountains can be seen off to the south and east.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description: The river makes a wide sweeping turn here into the mountain.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river flows west from here into the heart of the mountain and
east towards the foothills once more.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
You can barely make out what is ahead of you as the river flows
quietly through the passageway.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river slowly flows west towards the heart of the mountain.  There
are small cracks in the passage wall to the north where you might be able
to get up out of the water.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river continues east and west from here flowing south of a dark
ledge high above the water level.

Rooms.Name: On The Dark River
Rooms.Description:
The river flows south through a narrowing part of the passage as it
progresses deeper into the mountain.

Rooms.Name: On A Small Ledge
Rooms.Description:
You clamber out of the water up onto this narrow ledge to see if
it leads deeper into the mountain.  Unfortunately, the ledge is only
wide enough to rest upon for a while and there does not appear to be
any other exits other than rejoining the underground river.

Rooms.Name: On The Plains
Rooms.Description:
You stand on an open expanse of grass extending in all directions.
To the south of you stand the might northern gates of New Thalos.  East
and west of you the grassy fields continue and north, in the distance,
you see a line of trees.

Rooms.Name: On The Plains
Rooms.Description:
You stand on an open field of grass.  The forest to the north is
closer but still a good distance away.  To the south a small dirt
path has been trodden into the ground heading towards New Thalos.

Rooms.Name: The Edge Of The Forest
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the edge of a huge forest.  The line of trees
continues as far as the eye can see to the east and west.  A
large expanse of grass spreads out to the south.

Rooms.Name: River Ishtar
Rooms.Description:
The river broadens even more here and the waters become murky.
The smell of saltwater has reached you from the east.  The Dragon
Sea cannot be far away.  To the east you can see the faint outline
of a city and to the north you see a large expanse of grass.

Rooms.Name: The River Delta
Rooms.Description:
This is where the river empties out into the Dragon Sea.  The backwash
of water has kicked up a lot of sand and the blue sea is stained where
the river empties.  Looking west all you can see is water... all the way
to the horizon.  North of here is a small dock you think you should be
able to reach with out too much trouble.  The river stretches off to the
west back towards New Thalos.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
The Dragon Sea comes up along the shore here.  The deep blue waters
rolling in and crashing against the beach.  To the north you see a 
small dock jutting out into the surf.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the west.

Rooms.Name: On A Road
Rooms.Description:
The people of New Thalos take great pride in the services their
city may provide.  One of these services is the construction crews
the go to great lengths to keep all the roads in order.  Although
the taxes in New Thalos are higher then other cities in the realm
most of the money is used for the good of the people.

Rooms.Name: On A Road
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a well used road with beautiful scenery.  To the north
tall pine trees form a wall that goes on for miles.  Between the road
and the trees lies a great expanse of grassy plains.  South of here, 
beyond the river, lies the Great Eastern Desert.  The road continues
east and west.

Rooms.Name: On A Road
Rooms.Description:
The Dragon Sea can be seen to the east now spreading out to unknown
lands.  The road continues east and west.  To the south you hear the
sounds of boats traveling the River Ishtar delivering goods.

Rooms.Name: On A Road
Rooms.Description:
This is the man land route through the land.  Merchants can bring
their goods to the coastline and have them ferried onto ships for
export.  Travel by foot west will take you through New Thalos up and
over the Eastern Mountains and down into Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Near The Shore
Rooms.Description:
The road ends here turning into a small dirt path leading down the
beach and onto a dock.  To the north and south you see the coastline
stretching out before you.  West of here the lowlands roll up into
huge snow capped mountains.

Rooms.Name: On A Dock
Rooms.Description:
You stand on a simple wooden dock that acts as an extension of the
road to the west.  The dock seems to have been here for quite a long
time but is still sturdy.  A small ladder has been built on the eastern
end to allow easy access to and from ships.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends in
all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance you think
you might see a small dock to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
Rooms.Description:
The ocean spreads out in all directions rolling gently.  In the
distance you can see an island on the horizon.  To the west you see
the mainland.

Rooms.Name: Under The dock
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming underneath the dock.  You can see the four wooden
pylons that support the structure.  The murky water clouds you vision
as you gaze westward, but you think you can make out an iron grating
in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The Lair Of The Ixitxachitl
Rooms.Description:
Blood swirls around in the water as the Ixitxachitl devours the 
last of its meal.  Swirling around quickly as you intrude upon his
meal the large sting ray attacks!

Mobs.Name: mage guildmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
Mobs.Description: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.

Mobs.Name: cleric guildmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
Mobs.Description: An old man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.

Mobs.Name: warrior guildmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
Mobs.Description: A small man dressed in black robes stands here, waiting to train you.

Mobs.Name: thief guildmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
Mobs.Description:
A small human dressed in black rests in the corner. As you enter he grabs
a knife and throws it at you. It lands in the wall next to your left ear.
'We will now begin', is all he says.

Mobs.Name: receptionist woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A dark skinned, veiled woman greets you from behind the desk.
Mobs.Description:
This arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking official.
As you attempt to sneak a peek under her veil you notice a small moon-shaped
birth mark on her left cheek.

Mobs.Name: bartender man mage old
Mobs.LongDescription: An old withered man leans against the bar.
Mobs.Description: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.

Mobs.Name: john brother singer lead
Mobs.LongDescription: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes stands on stage.
Mobs.Description: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip synching to an old Zochan tune.

Mobs.Name: panhandler
Mobs.LongDescription: A panhandler rests here.
Mobs.Description: A small skinny man rests here, hoping to find a warm heart.

Mobs.Name: panhandler
Mobs.LongDescription: A panhandler rests here.
Mobs.Description: A small skinny man rests here, staring at your clothes.

Mobs.Name: beggar
Mobs.LongDescription: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
Mobs.Description: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?

Mobs.Name: baker
Mobs.LongDescription: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
Mobs.Description: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.

Mobs.Name: shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The shopkeeper sits here.
Mobs.Description: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.

Mobs.Name: banker
Mobs.LongDescription: A banker stands here waiting to help you.
Mobs.Description: This small halfling seems adept at counting money.

Mobs.Name: ahkeem tailor
Mobs.LongDescription: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
Mobs.Description:
This middle-aged man looks you over with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.

Mobs.Name: vera lady
Mobs.LongDescription: Vera the veggie lady beems as you look over her stand.
Mobs.Description: A tall slender woman stands before you, smiling broadly.

Mobs.Name: butch
Mobs.LongDescription: Butch the meatcutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
Mobs.Description:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in hes eye, as he twirls his cleaver
carelessly into the air.

Mobs.Name: abdul armorer
Mobs.LongDescription: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
Mobs.Description:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye. You quickly glance away under his
cold stare and place your order.

Mobs.Name: igor weaponsmith
Mobs.LongDescription: Igor stands here doing... something.
Mobs.Description: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.

Mobs.Name: cassandra
Mobs.LongDescription: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
Mobs.Description:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggests many years on the open
sea. It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand the 
smell that permeates the air.

Mobs.Name: foreman man
Mobs.LongDescription: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
Mobs.Description:
A worried looking dwarf stands here, constantly making notes in his book and
looking at his watch.

Mobs.Name: construction worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A construction worker steadily works here.
Mobs.Description: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote wipes off his sweaty brow with a handkerchief.; %10 grumble

Mobs.Name: statue brahman
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Brahman stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue made of solid marble depicts the mighty god defeating Siva in
magical combat.

Mobs.Name: statue siva
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Siva stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue of the High Lord of Destruction stands here, being attacked by
Brahman in magical combat.

Mobs.Name: statue indra
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Indra stands here.
Mobs.Description: This statue looks like an enormous elephant.

Mobs.Name: statue yama
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Yama stands here.
Mobs.Description: This is a statue of the God of Death. It is covered with odd runes.

Mobs.Name: statue surya
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Surya stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue of Surya, the God in charge of the Sun, almost glows with a
fiery aura.

Mobs.Name: statue kali
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Kali stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue of the Black Mother Kali is made of black marble and is covered
with silver runes.

Mobs.Name: statue brihaspati
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Brihaspati stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue of Brihaspati, the God of Scholars and Knowledge is made of a
weathered marble.

Mobs.Name: statue puchan
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Puchan stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The statue of Puchan, God of Travellers, is covered with dust and worn as if
it had been dragged a long way down a dusty road.

Mobs.Name: aziz human canon
Mobs.LongDescription: Aziz the Human Canon stands here.

Mobs.Name: mustafah human robber
Mobs.LongDescription: Mustafah the Human Robber stands here.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 snicker; %10 emote greedily counts some money.

Mobs.Name: fatima elf invoker
Mobs.LongDescription: Fatima the Elven Invoker stands here.

Mobs.Name: kareem dwarf mercenary
Mobs.LongDescription: Kareem the Dwarven Mercenary stands here.

Mobs.Name: nomad merchant
Mobs.LongDescription: A nomad merchant looks you over.
Mobs.Description:
This robust fellow returns your gaze with a smile, but something inside you
tells you not to trust him very far.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 smirk; %15 say You wanna buy? Spezzial prize for you, mizzter!

Mobs.Name: bodyguard guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A bodyguard sizes you up.
Mobs.Description: This large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.

Mobs.Name: kid thief
Mobs.LongDescription: A skinny kid wanders around.
Mobs.Description: This small child sees you looking at him and quickly looks away.

Mobs.Name: dockworker
Mobs.LongDescription: A strong dockworker walks by moving crates.
Mobs.Description:
Although seemingly dull witted, this hulking mass carries the huge crates
from the boats like it was a box of lilies.

Mobs.Name: man taxcollector
Mobs.LongDescription: A small man walks around scribbling in a notebook.
Mobs.Description:
The city's taxcollector walks from store to store, collecting the Sultan's
fee for living in his grand city.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%10 snicker; 
%15 emote looks you over with a penetrating and somewhat greedy look.

Mobs.Name: gord
Mobs.LongDescription: Gord the Rogue stands here.

Mobs.Name: chulainn knight
Mobs.LongDescription: Chulainn the Knight stands here.
Mobs.Description:
This large man does not seem to be surprised at your approach and looks at you
quizzically.

Mobs.Name: daghdha
Mobs.LongDescription: Daghdha the Arch-Magi stands here.
Mobs.Description: This man is dressed in long brown robes and has a penetrating gaze.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote pulls a burning cigarette out of his ear with a grin.; %10 pose

Mobs.Name: curley greenleaf
Mobs.LongDescription: Curley GreenLeaf stands here.

Mobs.Name: man wandering prophet
Mobs.LongDescription: A small grey-haired man walks around spouting gospel.
Mobs.Description:
This sad case may have been an evangelist in another lifetime. He is known to
stand in corners and accost passers-by with his doomsday preaching.

Mobs.Name: alley cat
Mobs.LongDescription: A small harmless feline searches for food.
Mobs.Description: You see a small starved cat.

Mobs.Name: vulture
Mobs.LongDescription: A vulture circles above you.
Mobs.Description: As you look up at this bird, you see that the only thing it wants is a corpse.

Mobs.Name: old man
Mobs.LongDescription: An old man sits here playing chess.
Mobs.Description: He seems intent on winning.

Mobs.Name: lugh librarian
Mobs.LongDescription: Lugh the Librarian sits behind a desk.
Mobs.Description: This huge hulking mass rises, as someone asks him a question.

Mobs.Name: dust devil
Mobs.LongDescription: The wind kicks up some dust.
Mobs.Description: What you see before you is really a baby air elemental.

Mobs.Name: lamia beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
Mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beatiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

Mobs.Name: dervish
Mobs.LongDescription: A raggety dervish stands here.
Mobs.Description: This man looks like he could use a lot of rest.

Mobs.Name: sultan
Mobs.LongDescription: The Sultan rests here on his throne.
Mobs.Description: You see a large wealthy man in red robes smiling at you.

Mobs.Name: harem girl
Mobs.LongDescription: A lovely, veiled harem girl stands here.
Mobs.Description:
You see a dark skinned beauty, wearing almost transparent silks and a light
blue veil. Her loyalty to the Sultan is unwavering.

Mobs.Name: jailer
Mobs.LongDescription: The Jailer is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
You see a pathetic soul resting here. Probably some ex-nobleman that has
fallen out of grace with the Sultan.

Mobs.Name: eunuch
Mobs.LongDescription: A eunuch stands here watching over the girls.
Mobs.Description:
You see a large man whose only duty is to protect the harem. He has been
castrated for the ladies' safety.

Mobs.Name: sultans favorite girl nichole
Mobs.LongDescription: Nichole, the Sultan's favorite girl rests on a mound of pillows.
Mobs.Description:
You see the most beautiful Arabian girl that has ever met your eyes. Too bad
she is about to kill you.

Mobs.Name: krishna statue
Mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Krishna is standing here.
Mobs.Description:
This is a statue of the God Vishnu's most radiant incarnation,
the heroic Krishna.

Mobs.Name: mage guildguard
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stand here.
Mobs.Description: This man looks like a mage/warrior. I wouldn't mess with him.

Mobs.Name: cleric guildguard
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
Mobs.Description: This man looks like a cleric/warrior. I wouldn't mess with him.

Mobs.Name: warrior guildguard
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
Mobs.Description: This man looks like Conan's cousin. I wouldn't mess with him.

Mobs.Name: thief guildguard
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of theives stands here.
Mobs.Description:
You see a thief dressed all in black. He quickly stands as you enter and
steps to bar your way. You notice his hands resting on two sheathes.

Mobs.Name: servant boy
Mobs.LongDescription: A servant boy is here running errands.
Mobs.Description: You see a small boy running around in the halls of the palace.

Mobs.Name: sultans guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
Mobs.Description: You see a trained fighter, ready to help those in need.

Mobs.Name: sultans guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A guard stands here, watching the gate.
Mobs.Description: You see a trained fighter, ready to defend the city.

Mobs.Name: sultans guard chief
Mobs.LongDescription: The Chief of the Sultan's Guard stands here.
Mobs.Description: You see a large man skilled in hunting and killing.

Mobs.Name: mercenary
Mobs.LongDescription: A mercenary stands here waiting for a job.
Mobs.Description: You see an assassin down on his luck, looking to be freelanced out.

Mobs.Name: shipwright captain
Mobs.LongDescription: An old captain rests here carving on a stick.
Mobs.Description:
You see the shipwright of New Thalos, waiting to sell someone a boat. He beams
a smile at you through his beard, as you walk in.

Mobs.Name: blacksmith
Mobs.LongDescription: The blacksmith stands here pumping air into his fire.
Mobs.Description:
You see a large human,  dripping in sweat, standing before you. He takes
a break from his swealtering work to bid you welcome.

Mobs.Name: horse
Mobs.LongDescription: A horse stands here.
Mobs.Description: You see one of the fine Arabian beasts known about the land.

Mobs.Name: tourist
Mobs.LongDescription: A tourist stands here looking lost.
Mobs.Description:
You see a small rotund man with a strange object around his neck and a nose
guard. He is looking at a small map that he seems to be holding upside down.

Mobs.Name: ixitxachitl ray
Mobs.LongDescription: A very large ray with a wicked looking tail swims here.
Mobs.Description: You see a large ray with sharp fangs and a barbed tail.

Mobs.Name: cryohydra
Mobs.LongDescription: The cryohydra stands here.
Mobs.Description: A grey-brown reptilian creature with amber eyes stands before you.

Mobs.Name: minotaur lizard
Mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur lizard stands here.
Mobs.Description: A huge lizard-like reptile with horns like a minotaur.

Mobs.Name: dog death
Mobs.LongDescription: The death dog stands here.
Mobs.Description: A large two-headed hound barks at you vicously.

Mobs.Name: lion spotted
Mobs.LongDescription: The spotted lion stands here.
Mobs.Description: A large fierce dapple-skinned lion glares at you.

Mobs.Name: behir
Mobs.LongDescription: A behir slithers on the ground.
Mobs.Description: You see a large snake-like reptile with more than a dozen legs.

Mobs.Name: chimera creature lion goat dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A creature with three heads: lion, goat, and dragon stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The chimera is still a mystery, better left unexplored. This creature has
the hindquarters of a goat, the forepaws of a lion and the body of a red
dragon.

Mobs.Name: couatl
Mobs.LongDescription: A couatl hovers here.
Mobs.Description:
A beautiful creature with the body of a serpent and feathered wings, the
colour of the rainbow.

Mobs.Name: giant hornet
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant hornet hovers here.
Mobs.Description: It is a hornet, what else can be said?

Mobs.Name: pegasus
Mobs.LongDescription: The pegasus stands here, flexing its wings.
Mobs.Description:
A magnificent winged steed, this horse looks much like the arabian thorough-
breds you have seen in stables.

Mobs.Name: elvira
Mobs.LongDescription: Elvira stands here mixing a love potion.
Mobs.Description:
You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing hair to
match her outfit.

Mobs.Name: braheem
Mobs.LongDescription: Braheem stands here talking to the walls.
Mobs.Description: You see a powerful but slightly insane mage.

Mobs.Name: high priest
Mobs.LongDescription: The high priest rests here meditating, well he WAS meditating.
Mobs.Description: He does NOT look real happy about you disturbing him.

Mobs.Name: royal guard elite
Mobs.LongDescription: An Elite Royal Guard stands here smiling happily.
Mobs.Description:
You see one of the Royal Guards of New Thalos who seems to have undergone
some heavy training.

Mobs.Name: patch bartender
Mobs.LongDescription: A large half-orc with a patch over one eye pours beer behind the counter.
Mobs.Description:
You see a really big guy here, who seems to have lost an eye in one manner
or another.

Mobs.Name: stitch
Mobs.LongDescription: Stitch, the leather dude reclines in his chair.
Mobs.Description:
You see a small hobbit with his feet kicked up on his desk, waiting for some
sucker, uhm customer to walk into his store.

Mobs.Name: gardener elf
Mobs.LongDescription: A small elf stands here tending the garden.
Mobs.Description:
A young elf stands here in dirt-covered overalls. He seems to be weeding his
garden.

Mobs.Name: nightmare demon horse
Mobs.LongDescription: A large horse, black as night, stands here.
Mobs.Description:
You see the largest horse you have ever seen before. Standing 10 feet at the
shoulders, it breathes flames from his nostrils and leaps to attack you.

Mobs.Name: wolverine wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: A large wolf-like creature leaps out from the darkness.
Mobs.Description: You see a powerful-looking beast with sharp fangs and huge claws.

Mobs.Name: mimic painting
Mobs.LongDescription: You see an incredibly life-like painting of the Sultan's mother.
Mobs.Description: Boy is she ugly.

Mobs.Name: mayor rabbit
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mayor of New Thalos stands here.
Mobs.Description: You see a chubby rabbit dressed in his best suit.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 chuckle; %10 chortle; %10 say What a beautiful day!

Mobs.Name: chef
Mobs.LongDescription: The chef stands here making dinner.
Mobs.Description: You see a very large human who seems to taste everything he makes.

Mobs.Name: evil beggar
Mobs.LongDescription: A beggar stands here, asking for gold.
Mobs.Description:
The beggar looks oddly familiar... you note that he is wearing the
faded colors of a master assassin.
Mobs.ActionScript: 10% chuckle; 10% cackle; 10% sigh; 10% say I am Evil!
